g.text: 1 Escalation is immediate on the raw threshold (one frame, no dwell, no smoothing).
2 De-escalation needs d ≥ threshold + 0.08 mm (≈ 2 × inferred sample noise, assuming independence) continuously for 250 ms (dwell);
robust σ(Δh) = 0.052 mm → σ(sample) ≈ 0.037 mm; gaps / new escalations restart dwell; Critical → Clear can be direct.
3 Missing data never lowers the level: within the 400 ms grace the level is held, afterwards it is cleared (not "Clear").
